[[File:Gilad_Halsek.png|thumb|right|150px|Consul-General [[Gilad Halsek]].]]
'''Consul-General''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] title held by officials in charge of consulates. [[Skalus]] held the title during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in his capacity as head of the Imperial [[consulate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Asation]] in the [[Gree Enclave/Legends|Gree Enclave]].<ref name="Journal8">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref> [[Dandamont Pring]] held that title on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. The consul-general of Kothlis was overseeing the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] consuls of the [[Bothan Colonial Board]], the local government; he was not only a voting member, but also had the authority to overturn the board's decisions. [[Gilad Halsek]] was the Consul-General of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="planets">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
